schema.name: Manna Bakery Menu
schema.description: The current breakfast, lunch, coffee, tea, and house-made favorites served at Manna Bakery in Tomball, Texas.

hasMenuSection.name: Drinks: Coffee & Espresso
hasMenuSection.description: Standard espresso drinks are $6 small or $7 large.

hasMenuItem.name: Brewed Tea
hasMenuItem.description: English Breakfast, Earl Grey, Mint Tea, or Decaf Black.

hasMenuSection.name: Drinks: Syrups
hasMenuSection.description: $0.75 each. Sugar-free options are marked below.

hasMenuItem.name: Breakfast Taco
hasMenuItem.description: Warm flour tortilla stuffed with fluffy scrambled eggs, melted cheese, and your choice of bacon or sausage.

hasMenuItem.name: Kolache
hasMenuItem.description: Soft, slightly sweet dough filled with savory sausage and melted cheese, available with or without jalapeño.

hasMenuItem.name: Biscuits & Gravy
hasMenuItem.description: Fluffy house biscuits topped with creamy house sausage gravy seasoned with sage and pepper.

hasMenuItem.name: Liège Waffle
hasMenuItem.description: A rich yeasted waffle with a caramelized sugar crust, paired with berries and whipped cream.

hasMenuItem.name: Breakfast Sandwich
hasMenuItem.description: Egg and cheese with sausage or ham on sourdough bread, a croissant, or a biscuit.

hasMenuItem.name: Quiche
hasMenuItem.description: A house favorite creamy egg custard. Available with bacon, sausage, veggies, meat lovers, or a seasonal flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: Stuffed French Toast
hasMenuItem.description: Vanilla-battered house bread stuffed with sweet cream cheese, topped with strawberries and whipped cream. Syrup on the side. The gluten-free version is also eggless.

hasMenuItem.name: Avocado Toast
hasMenuItem.description: Two slices of toasted artisan bread layered with fresh smashed avocado over a bed of arugula, finished with sliced tomato and everything seasoning.

hasMenuSection.name: Breakfast: Scratch Pastries
hasMenuSection.description: Our scratch pastries are self-serve from the bakery case.

hasMenuItem.name: The Italian
hasMenuItem.description: Fresh pepperoni, salami, ham, and provolone rolled with lettuce, pepperoncinis, red onion, red vinegar, olive oil, mayo, and oregano. Wrapped in our fresh scratch bread.

hasMenuItem.name: Turkey or Ham
hasMenuItem.description: Fresh turkey or ham and provolone rolled with lettuce, tomato, red onion, and mayo. Wrapped in our fresh scratch bread.

hasMenuItem.name: Ham & Honey Mustard Panini
hasMenuItem.description: Ham, Swiss cheese, and honey mustard sandwiched between two slices of our scratch buttered sourdough. Toasted until golden.

hasMenuItem.name: Turkey Pesto Panini
hasMenuItem.description: Turkey, provolone, and basil pesto sandwiched between two slices of our scratch buttered sourdough and toasted until golden.

hasMenuItem.name: Grilled Cheese Panini
hasMenuItem.description: Cheddar and provolone sandwiched between two slices of our from-scratch buttered sourdough and toasted until golden.

hasMenuItem.name: Chicken Salad Sandwich
hasMenuItem.description: Made with white chicken, mayo, celery, pecans, craisins, pineapple, and poppy seeds. Served on a croissant or sourdough.

hasMenuItem.name: Cuban Sandwich
hasMenuItem.description: Seasoned carnitas pork and house ham layered with Swiss cheese, Cuban mustard, and pickles on our house-baked bread.

hasMenuItem.name: Navajo Tacos
hasMenuItem.description: A plate-sized, flat, golden frybread topped with seasoned beef, beans, greens, tomato, cheese, and sour cream—a hearty, handcrafted Southwestern classic.

hasMenuItem.name: House 3-Meat Chili
hasMenuItem.description: Rough-cut steak tips, smoky bacon, and seasoned ground beef slow-simmered into a bold, hearty chili. Served with a slice of our silky-sweet house cornbread.

hasMenuItem.name: Caesar Salad
hasMenuItem.description: Chopped romaine hearts, shredded parmesan, herb croutons, and creamy Caesar dressing.

hasMenuItem.name: Mandarin Crunch
hasMenuItem.description: Spring mix, mandarin oranges, almonds, sesame seeds, red onion, and sesame ginger dressing.

hasMenuItem.name: Strawberry Fields
hasMenuItem.description: Spinach and spring mix, strawberries, candied pecans, feta, and raspberry vinaigrette.

hasMenuItem.name: House Salad
hasMenuItem.description: Chopped romaine lettuce, tomato, red onion, croutons, shredded cheddar, and ranch dressing.

hasMenuSection.name: Lunch: Soups
hasMenuSection.description: Two to three varieties are served daily. Available by the cup or bowl.

hasMenuItem.name: Chicken Tortilla
hasMenuItem.description: Chicken in a zesty broth, topped with cheese and a touch of cilantro for a little Southwest flair.

hasMenuItem.name: Zuppa Toscana
hasMenuItem.description: A creamy, comforting soup made with Italian sausage, tender potatoes, and fresh spinach.

hasMenuItem.name: Chophouse Potato
hasMenuItem.description: Hearty chunks of potato in a creamy base with smoked bacon and chives.

hasMenuItem.name: Tomato Basil
hasMenuItem.description: A rich blend of ripe tomatoes and fresh basil simmered to creamy perfection.
